points.text: Taste rule for the agent engineer:
This means: You choose — what to build AI writes — the code that does it You verify — that the result matches the intent AI fixes — what you flagged as wrong

points: You follow the taste rule for the agent engineer.
You choose what to build while the AI writes the code.
You verify that the result matches your intent and the AI fixes what you flag as wrong.
The ENERV pipeline serves as a real example.
